evidence_classes.original_run: summary/132 metrics/20 engine markers/20 migration+20 bulk reopen markers; source hashes verified against recorded commit with Git checkout LF/CRLF variants
evidence_classes.observational: cross-build wall-time comparisons are clues, not isolated causal gains
evidence_classes.controlled: M152 and M153 same-seed ABBA in their own ledgers
evidence_classes.diagnostic: M154 stage split and M155 measurement/gate validation

decisions.implemented: M152 defers freelist publication during reclamation while preserving page/double-write/failure contracts
decisions.remaining: 20M still has page/double-write/sync cost; M152 measured 12k ABBA only, no final 20M proof

decisions.implemented: M153 uses borrowed classification and only copies retained page values
decisions.remaining: 20M count/search improvement and export/migration superlinear growth are not verified by 200k search ABBA

decisions.implemented: M154 isolates delete-write/threshold-flush/memory-WAL sync; no speculative production algorithm change
decisions.remaining: 20M 46.714s vacuum lacks new split; 200k C SSD threshold flush is a diagnostic, not 20M attribution

decisions.implemented: M155 actual bounded history deletion, lock wait/hold, heap/RSS, normal reopen, stop phases, JSON raw and interval deltas
decisions.remaining: final complete five-scale throughput rerun not performed

limits: Old bounded metrics follow full vacuum and remove zero history; they only prove empty scan cost
Normal close/reopen preserves Windows page cache and is not power-loss durability validation
CSV heap deltas are not RSS; streaming buffer peak is not total memory or migration destination cost
Exact-total search scans the full visible keyspace; search_last_page is a specialized tail-page API, not arbitrary offset
Nested maintenance timers cannot be summed; derived _DELTA is a sampling interval and can include unsampled operations
No blanket claim that all degradation or synchronization costs are solved
